page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top; main text in one block of full lines; marginal notes in the left margin (Greek/Latin references such as "ASIATICA", "Agathias", "Teixeras", "Socrates", "Nicephorus") and a small note at the right margin edge.

main_text.p: Martis gladium nactus, praetextu non foluti ex pacto tributi, per Iftrum conglaciatum, exerci-tum in citeriorem Daciam immifit. Ineo, Arne-gislus, cum Anthemio miffus, in ipfo praelio defe-cit. Anthemius ad Sardicam conclufum, & mul-tis certaminibus fatigatum, in fugam conjecit, & pace promiffa, fi Collegam defertorem interemis-fent, facile quod petiit, impetravit. Abeotem-pore nihil memorabile geftum eft. Altero poft anno, cum, equo in venatione delapfus, vexe-bram dorfi luxaffet, mortuus eft. Supinam ejus in fubfcribendis libellis negligentiam, Placidia, venditione uxoris impetrata, correxit.
main_text.head: CONTEMPORANEA.
main_text.p: ASIATICA In PERSIA Jazdigerde † mortuo, fucceffit. Agathias Bahram cognomento Ghur, id eft, Onager, quod venatione eorum delectaretur, feu Vararanes III, lib. 4. Teixeras quem excepit * Jazdigerdes. Bahram in Arabia, ex confilio medicorum, a Nahamanno Regulo & Socrates I, 7. filio ejus Almanfore educatus, armis regnum, c. 18. 20. quod Cofroes quidam favore procerum Rex factus eft, recuperare coactus eft. Eo occupato cum importuno Epifcopi Audae (qui Pyraeum, in Niceph. I, 14. quo facer Perfarum ignis aflervabatur, deleverat) Zelo commotus, perfecutionem contra Chriftianos moviffet, Theodofio profugos tradere nolen-ti, bellum intulit. Vario primo Marte res acta eft, cum Ardabarius Nifibin obfediffet, Varatae-nes, Alamanduro Saraceno in auxilium evocato, obfidionem folviffet: tandem Saraceni, nocturno no praelio territi, plerique fe in Euphratem praecipites.

page.notes: Marginal text is partly faint and cut at the gutter; the readings of the left-margin references (e.g. "Nicephorus I, 14", "cap. 21") and the right-edge running fragments are doubtful. Right-margin text cut off at the page edge.
